body: claimed: Codex (uma) · 2026-11-18T06:21:55Z · branch mkinney:issue/1992-properties-reach · plan: reproduce reachability of the reported Properties controls at 1280 x 720, then fix any inaccessible row.

Looks already fixed on upstream/main c0c92ee86: the six reachability probes pass without a product change. Suggest closing; the maintainer decides.

The probes run the real shell at 1280 x 720.
They use ordinary pointer wheel events and pointer clicks.
The dock intentionally scrolls in both directions.
Off-edge AccessKit rectangles alone do not show that a control is unreachable.

These six tests pass:
- model_budget_set_is_reachable_at_1280_by_720 commits the STEP facet budget with Set.
- operation_delete_is_reachable_at_1280_by_720 deletes Contour1.
- operation_pick_remove_is_reachable_at_1280_by_720 removes its picked feature with ×.
- wcs_pick_is_reachable_at_1280_by_720 arms Pick for WCS after scrolling down.
- setup_tool_edit_is_reachable_at_1280_by_720 opens the named tool after scrolling across.
- catalog_last_add_is_reachable_at_1280_by_720 adds the last offered tool, EDM-W025, after scrolling.

The tests live under egui_app::tests::properties_reach in a temporary local probe.
The command was cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib properties_reach -- --nocapture.
It reports 6 passed and 0 failed.

There is one limitation.
Setup Edit's center click is intercepted after scrolling.
Its exposed upper strip works: clicking at the button's top plus 2 pixels opens EM-0600-4FL.
A floating scrollbar overlap is suspected, not proven.

Likely related fixes are 5656f9552, which puts Geometry remove buttons first, and 6c0c62c61, which makes Tool list tables scroll across.
Commit 540b3a970 moved and wrapped the WCS feature-pick controls.
Pick for WCS now lives on the WCS page rather than Setup settings.

Claim released. No product changes or PR.
